content: Acme quoted $48,000/yr for 200 seats to Northwind Traders (Aug 2026), undercutting us by 12%. Includes onboarding free, renewal uplift capped at 5%. Source: discovery call notes from rep Priya S.
Acme launched SSO + SCIM provisioning in v4.2 (Aug 12). Gap closed vs us on enterprise auth, but their audit logs only retain 30 days vs our 365 days. Confirmed via Acme changelog + SE review.
WON vs Acme at Globex Logistics ($96K ARR, 350 seats). Won on 365-day audit retention + India data residency. Acme could not commit to Mumbai region hosting. Champion: CTO Maria D.
LOST to Acme at BluePeak Retail ($54K ARR). Reason: Acme offered 20% discount + free migration. Our price $68K was seen as too high for 150 seats. Lesson: need SMB discount tier.
Acme enterprise tier is $22/user/month billed annually, $27 month-to-month. Volume break at 500+ seats drops to $18. Intel from Acme pricing page archived Sep 1 + partner tip.
WON vs Acme at CareWell Hospitals ($120K ARR). Decisive: HIPAA BAA + on-call support SLA 99.99%. Acme support is chat-only on standard plan. Champion: CISO Dr. Rao.
Nova quoted $36,000/yr flat for up to 500 seats to FinEdge Startup (Jul 2026). Aggressive flat-rate land-and-expand play. Renewal jumps to $60K in year 2 per their rep.
Nova shipped AI summarizer v2 (Aug 2026) but it only supports English. Our multilingual support (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil) is a clear differentiator in APAC deals. Tested in Nova trial workspace.
Nova lacks offline mode and mobile MDM controls. Lost a 400-seat field-services deal because technicians need offline sync. Our offline-first client won the technical validation.
WON vs Nova at EduSpark ($44K ARR, 600 seats EDU). Won on per-student pricing + LMS integration (Moodle/Canvas). Nova charges full per-seat with no EDU discount.
LOST to Nova at BrightCart D2C ($38K ARR). Nova's Shopify plug-and-play connector went live in 1 day; our custom integration needed 2 weeks. Need faster SMB onboarding.
Nova Pro is $15/user/month, Business $24. Annual prepay saves 20%. No implementation fee under 100 seats. Source: Nova pricing call with AE Kevin L. on Sep 12.
Vertex quoted $210K/yr for 1000-seat enterprise at Sterling Bank (Aug 2026). Premium positioning 2.5x our price, but includes dedicated CSM + custom DPA. Procurement pushed back on cost.
Vertex has SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 + EU data residency (Frankfurt). Feature parity on compliance. We differentiate on Mumbai + Hyderabad regions for DPDP Act alignment.
Vertex API rate limit is 100 req/min on standard, 1000 on enterprise. Our limit is 2000/min default. Vertex customers complain about webhook delays >5 min in community forum (Aug thread).
WON vs Vertex at AeroFab Manufacturing ($150K ARR, 800 seats). Won on offline-first + SAP integration delivered in 3 weeks. Vertex quoted 12-week services engagement at $40K extra.
LOST to Vertex at Meridian Insurance ($180K ARR). Vertex's actuarial reporting templates + Snowflake native connector were decisive. We had no equivalent vertical pack. Build insurance template pack.
WON vs Vertex at CityGrid Utilities ($88K ARR, 450 seats). Won on Hindi/Telugu UI + IVR fallback for field crews. Vertex English-only UI failed user acceptance with 60 field staff.
